name: ClassWaitlistManager
tagline: Fill every seat: ranked waitlists, timed offers, auto-promotion and permission numbers for class sections.
description: A Power Apps component for registrars and departments to manage section capacity and waitlists: priority-ranked queues, seat offers with expiry, automatic promotion of the next eligible student, holds and credit-load checks, permission numbers for over-capacity approvals and a full activity log. Works in Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages, with a dedicated phone layout.
features: Section board with capacity bars, status and waitlist caps
Priority-group or first-come ranking with manual reorder
Seat offers with expiry countdown and overdue release
Manual, suggest and automatic promotion modes
Registration holds and credit-load eligibility checks
Keyboard and touch operation, ARIA roles
Configurable labels, colours and priority groups
